title: QueueAtlas synthetic reference corpus
provenance: Hand-written synthetic logs; no production records or real credentials.

defaults.line_order: file order unless a scenario says otherwise

outcome_vocabulary.sent_local: Postfix local transport reports delivery to maildir.
outcome_vocabulary.sent_remote: A remote SMTP server accepted the message; mailbox delivery is unproven.
outcome_vocabulary.sent_lmtp: The LMTP peer acknowledged the recipient; Dovecot evidence is separate.
outcome_vocabulary.sent_pipe: A pipe transport accepted the message; downstream processing is unproven.
outcome_vocabulary.deferred: A temporary failure was observed and the queue may retry.
outcome_vocabulary.bounced: Postfix reports a permanent delivery failure for this recipient.
outcome_vocabulary.expired: The queued message exceeded its lifetime; delivery is unproven.
outcome_vocabulary.rejected_prequeue: SMTP rejection before this recipient acquired a Queue ID.
outcome_vocabulary.unknown: The available lines do not establish a final recipient result.

facts: Inbound SMTP client 192.0.2.10
Queue 01A1B2C3D4 created and removed
forbidden: Do not infer anything about later mailbox reads.

facts: Authenticated submission by alice@example.org
Remote SMTP reply contains an unrelated remote queue token
forbidden: Do not call remote SMTP acceptance a mailbox delivery.
Do not create a local queue from REMOTE02.

facts: Local pickup from uid 1001, not an SMTP connection
forbidden: Do not invent a client IP or SASL account.

facts: One queue has three recipients with different outcomes
The SMTP failure response contains nested parentheses
forbidden: Do not mark the whole queue successful or permanently failed.
Do not collapse the three recipient attempts.

facts: One RCPT is rejected before enqueue while a different RCPT in the same SMTP session is accepted
forbidden: Do not assign the rejected RCPT to queue 05A1B2C3D4 as a proven fact.

facts: NOQUEUE rejection has no queue instance
forbidden: Do not create a queue whose ID is NOQUEUE.
Do not report a later delivery.

facts: Two delivery attempts for one recipient: temporary failure then remote acceptance
forbidden: Do not discard the deferred attempt.
Do not infer mailbox delivery.

facts: Three attempts with distinct DSNs and replies
forbidden: Do not overwrite or merge the two deferred attempts.

facts: Queue 09F1B2C3D4 is a separate non-delivery notification with an empty envelope sender
forbidden: Do not treat delivery of the notification as delivery of the original message.

facts: The queue is explicitly marked expired after a temporary failure
A notification queue ID is named but no lines for that queue are present
forbidden: Do not claim the notification reached the sender.
Do not convert the earlier deferral into a permanent remote rejection.

facts: The filter reply explicitly says queued as 11F1B2C3D4
The second queue is observed on the same Postfix instance with matching sender, recipient and Message-ID
The first queue is accepted by a local filter, the second by local delivery
forbidden: Do not call the first filter acceptance final delivery.
Do not erase either queue from the journey.

facts: A local filter says queued as 12F1B2C3D4, but no target queue lines exist
forbidden: Do not create a confirmed target QueueInstance from the reply alone.
Do not claim final recipient delivery.

facts: Queue ID 13A1B2C3D4 appears in two separate generations on mx-a
Each generation has a distinct Message-ID, sender and recipient
Both generations have an explicit removed event
forbidden: Do not merge both generations into one message.
Do not apply the later sender to the first generation.

facts: Both independent Postfix instances use Queue ID 14A1B2C3D4 at the same time
forbidden: Do not fuse the two queues on ID equality.
Do not invent an interhost transfer.

facts: Two unrelated queue IDs share the exact Message-ID
forbidden: Do not merge queues solely by Message-ID.

facts: File order differs from event timestamp order
A late cleanup line adds the Message-ID
forbidden: Do not drop the late cleanup observation.
Do not use file order as proof that delivery preceded enqueue.

facts: Only a deferred delivery attempt and a removed event are available
No sender, Message-ID, creation or later success is observed
forbidden: Do not invent a sender or Message-ID.
Do not turn removed into proof of delivery or bounce.

facts: The LMTP peer acknowledges recipient bob@example.org
forbidden: Do not invent a Dovecot observation when no Dovecot log is present.

facts: The virtual transport reports maildir delivery
forbidden: Do not misclassify virtual as remote SMTP.

facts: The named pipe transport accepted a message
forbidden: Do not claim the downstream archive processed or stored it.

facts: orig_to=sales@example.org differs from the final recipient
Local delivery says forwarded as 21F1B2C3D4 and that queue is observed
forbidden: Do not replace the original recipient with orig_to.
Do not call remote SMTP acceptance mailbox delivery.

facts: A quoted local part contains SQL metacharacters
The SMTP reply contains HTML-looking text, commas, equals signs and nested parentheses
The HELO field contains HTML-looking text
forbidden: Do not execute or render log fields as HTML, URL or SQL.
Do not treat this prequeue rejection as a queued recipient.

facts: These two files model a rename/create rotation boundary
Postfix master restarts and PID changes
One queue spans both file generations
forbidden: Do not split a QueueInstance solely because the log file or process PID changed.
Do not count either line twice after restart.

facts: The gzip stream decompresses byte-for-byte to the plain log
The two inputs intentionally overlap
forbidden: Do not double count the same proven event when both inputs are imported.
Do not assume differently sourced lines are duplicates without matching evidence.

facts: Rspamd reports qid 25A1B2C3D4, score 1.20, action no action
Postfix LMTP reports Saved
Dovecot independently reports saving matching recipient and Message-ID
forbidden: Do not require optional sources for the Postfix result.
Do not equate Message-ID equality alone with a proven Dovecot link.

facts: The first delivery line has malformed DSN
The second delivery line is a valid sent event
The third line has no syslog envelope
forbidden: Do not silently normalize not-a-dsn to a valid DSN.
Do not crash or discard the raw malformed records.

facts: RFC5424 envelope has explicit +02:00 offset and process ID
12:26 local time corresponds to 10:26 UTC
forbidden: Do not treat the explicit offset as UTC.
Do not mistake structured-data NILVALUE for message text.

facts: RFC3164 lines have no year or timezone
The second line is 2027-01-01, two seconds after the first
forbidden: Do not assign both lines to 2026.
Do not claim timestamp certainty beyond the supplied source anchor.

facts: One complete line exceeds 128 KiB because its untrusted SMTP response contains repeated X characters
forbidden: Do not allocate without a configured bound or crash.
Do not claim a verified bounce if the configured line limit rejects the record.

facts: The file ends without a newline after status= and represents a pending partial record
forbidden: Do not commit a partial line as a complete sent or deferred event.
Do not advance the durable offset beyond an uncommitted partial record.
